name: Rodney Fox Shark Expeditions
summary: Liveaboard trips of three to nine nights from Port Lincoln to the Neptune Islands to see great white sharks from a surface cage, or from an ocean floor cage for certified divers. No dive qualification is needed for the surface cage, and most trips add a sea lion swim and a walk on the islands. The company has run great white shark tours since 1965.
standouts: ECO Certified, Advanced Ecotourism (Ecotourism Australia logo on the site)
Ocean Floor Cage dives to about 20 metres for certified SCUBA divers
32m MV Rodney Fox, 9 guest cabins, maximum 18 guests

contact.address: 107 Henley Beach Road, Mile End, SA, 5031

trips.title: Great White Expedition (4 days/3 Nights)
trips.summary: Three nights on the MV Rodney Fox at the Neptune Islands with time in the surface cage and, for certified divers, the ocean floor cage. The first afternoon includes a snorkel with Australian sea lions at Hopkins Island. There is no time limit in the cages as long as everyone gets a fair share.
highlights: Snorkel with Australian sea lions at Hopkins Island on day 1
Surface Cage for all guests, Ocean Floor Cage for certified SCUBA divers
Tender boat trip to the fur seals and a walk on the Neptune Islands
Great White Shark Research Talk on board

trips.title: Great White Shark Expedition 6 Day/5 Night
trips.summary: Six days and five nights on board, with five days set aside for great white shark diving at the North and South Neptune Islands. The trip also includes one or two dives with Australian sea lions and a tender boat tour of the fur seal colonies. Evenings bring local food and wine and a shark research talk.
highlights: Five days of shark diving at the North and South Neptune Islands
One or two Australian sea lion dives
Tender boat tour of the long-nosed fur seal colonies
Walking tour on the Neptune Islands, conditions permitting

Leafy sea dragons and seasonal giant cuttlefish breeding can be added

offers.text: No Shark Policy: if no sharks are sighted on your first expedition, each guest gets a credit voucher worth half the cabin cost toward a return trip
offers.conditions: Return expedition must be booked within 2 years. Based on cabin price, excluding SCUBA hire, marine park fees and wifi. Not available on some special hosted tours or special itineraries unless approved by the office. Non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Private charters and film crew bookings are excluded.

checkNotes: All dated prices are 'from' prices in the Tour Dates table (/bookings/), read 12 Oct 2026; cabin and diver options (surface vs ocean floor, sole occupancy) are only inside the Rezdy widget, which was not opened. Rezdy links on the site carry a ?date=YYYY-MM-DD parameter per departure; recorded here without it. Marine park fees, scuba and wetsuit hire, alcohol, flights and insurance are not included (FAQ). Payment terms: deposit at booking and balance 60 days before departure; card surcharge applies (Terms). The office address is in Mile End (Adelaide); trips leave from Port Lincoln, with the Marina Hotel as the stated meeting point. Phone shown as +61 (0)8 8363 1788; email expeditions@rodneyfox.com.au is from the FAQ. The museum (foxtozermuseum.com) is a separate land-based venue in Adelaide and was not included. Several 'only in the world' and exclusive-access claims appear on the site (only liveaboard at the Neptune Islands, exclusive shore rights); kept out of standouts except where the ocean floor cage is described factually.
